description: Create an account in a ledger (POST /v1/organizations/{org}/ledgers/{ledger}/accounts). Accounts hold balances per asset code (e.g. BRL, USD, USDC).

alias.description: Optional unique alias (used as @alias in transaction operations)

asset_code.description: Asset the account holds (e.g. BRL, USD)

extra.description: Any additional Midaz account fields, merged into the payload

type.description: Account type (e.g. deposit, savings, creditCard, expense)

name: create_account
